text:
Rina: Quick decision needed: customer wants an "investigation view" for rollouts (cost delta + error spike drilldown). Need 3 scoped options by EOD.
Owen: Proposal A (light): aggregated card showing cost/error by model_variant + link to filtered traces. Low risk.
Kei: Proposal B (sampled): add hashed_tenant & model_variant propagation and capture sampled token timelines for flagged tenants. Medium cost.
Marta: Proposal C (full): exact per-token attribution across batching, caching, reroutes. Large effort, kernel-level benches required.
Owen: Acceptance checklist draft for B: dashboard card, drill-to-sampled-trace, CSV export, per-tenant sampling toggle, privacy: tenant hash default.
Kei: Engineering note: naive token spans in hot loop blow CPU. Suggest emit aggregated per-request counters and emit token timelines only for sampled requests.
ops-bot: perf job queued perf-13001 ETA 48h.
Rina: Sales says they'll market Proposal B as "forensic audit" add-on. If benches look good we'll aim for MID. Meeting 3pm to finalize.
Marta: I'll bring the canary/rollback plan. Kei please bring perf constraints.
Owen: I'll draft the pre-read and acceptance criteria now. :thumbsup:
